title: Addressing flip map
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every sign vector $x$ of length $m+2^m$, the addressing flip map sends $x$ to the vector obtained by flipping the data coordinate selected by the address encoded in the first $m$ coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $m+2^m$
